Class MKRenderPipelines

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.MKRenderPipelines
@Internal public final class MKRenderPipelines extends Object
MenuKit-owned RenderPipelines for GUI rendering. Currently holds one pipeline: GUI_BRIGHTNESS_INVERTED, used by Button.sprite(...)'s pressed-state visual.

Config mirrors vanilla's 26.2 RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED (MATRICES_PROJECTION + SAMPLER0 bind groups, TRANSLUCENT color target, POSITION_TEX_COLOR vertex binding, QUADS topology, no depth state — GUI ordering is handled by strata now) with the fragment-shader stage swapped to a custom shader that inverts each pixel's HSL lightness channel while preserving hue and saturation.

The location identifier (menukit:pipeline/gui_brightness_inverted) is namespace-scoped to avoid colliding with vanilla or other-mod pipelines. Shaders live at assets/menukit/shaders/core/button_brightness_invert.vsh and .fsh.

Class is loaded lazily on first reference; static-field-initialized pipeline is fine because compilation is triggered by Mojang's renderer on first draw, not at class-load time.
